    """Add an operation to a setup. Required decisions:
      strategy: Fusion strategy string ("face","pocket2d","adaptive2d","contour2d",...)
      tool:     document-tool index (int) or description substring
      geometry: {"faces":[idx,...], "type":"pocket"|"contour"|"drill", "loop":.., "side":..}
                REQUIRED for area/contour/drilling strategies; omit for "face".
                For drilling-family strategies (drill, center drill, spot drill,
                bore, counterbore, tap) pass type="drill" with the hole faces.

    Tool is attached on the INPUT before add() (post-add setter is unreliable).
    Returns {"operation": <name>, "params": {param_name: {value, expression}, ...}}
    — the full Fusion parameter list is included so you can read param names and
    units, then pass them all to mb.set_params() in one call."""
    cam = get_cam()
    s = _find_setup(cam, setup)
    doc_tool = _doc_tool(cam, tool)

    inp = s.operations.createInput(strategy)
    inp.tool = doc_tool
    op = s.operations.add(inp)
    if name:
        op.name = name

    if op.tool is None:
        raise RuntimeError("operation has no tool after add() — tool attach failed")

    if geometry is not None:
        body = _all_bodies()[body_index]
        try:

        except Exception as e:
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"Op {op.name!r} created but geometry selection failed: {e}. "
                f"Fix with mb.set_geometry({op.name!r}, <corrected_geometry>) "
                f"— do NOT create a new operation.") from None

    adsk.doEvents()
    return {"operation": op.name, "params": _read_params(op)}

def strategy_guide(strategy: str) -> dict:
    """Parameter map for a strategy captured without geometry attached.

    Returns {param_name: {"expression": <default_expr>, "unit": <set_params_unit>}}.
    Covers most params (stepover, stepdown, feeds, speeds, heights, passes,
    compensation). A small number of geometry-dependent params may be absent —
    the "params" dict returned by add_operation() is the definitive list for
    a specific op once geometry is set.

    Use this before set_params() to look up exact parameter names without
    guessing. "unit" is the unit= string for set_params():
      "mm"     → length in mm or feed in mm/min
      "raw"    → dimensionless (RPM, counts, ratios, angles)
      "bool"   → True/False flag (e.g. doMultipleDepths)
      "choice" → quoted string for mode params (e.g. bottomHeight_mode)

    Returns {} for unknown/unprobed strategies."""
    return dict(_STRATEGY_PARAMS.get(strategy, {}))

def set_geometry(op_name, geometry, body_index=0):
    """Set or replace the geometry selection on an existing operation.
    Use this to fix a geometry error from add_operation() without recreating the op.
    geometry: {"faces":[idx,...], "type":"pocket"|"contour", "loop":.., "side":..}"""
    cam = get_cam()

    body = _all_bodies()[body_index]
    _select_geometry(op, body, geometry)

    """Faces of a body as compact dicts: index, type, area_mm2, centroid_mm, normal,
    z_mm. `kind` optionally filters by type substring (e.g. "Plane", "Cylinder").

    The face `index` is stable for the static part body, so the model selects
    machining geometry by passing these indices to add_operation(geometry=...)."""
    bodies = _all_bodies()
    if body_index < 0 or body_index >= len(bodies):
        raise RuntimeError(f"body_index {body_index} out of range (have {len(bodies)})")
    body = bodies[body_index]
    res = []
    for i in range(body.faces.count):
        f = body.faces.item(i)
        ftype = _face_type(f)
        if kind and kind.lower() not in ftype.lower():
            continue
        entry = {"index": i, "type": ftype, "area_mm2": round(f.area * MM * MM, 3)}
        try:
            pt = f.pointOnFace
            entry["centroid_mm"] = [round(pt.x * MM, 3), round(pt.y * MM, 3), round(pt.z * MM, 3)]
            ev = f.evaluator
            ok, prm = ev.getParameterAtPoint(pt)
            if ok:
                ok2, nrm = ev.getNormalAtParameter(prm)
                if ok2:
                    entry["normal"] = [round(nrm.x, 4), round(nrm.y, 4), round(nrm.z, 4)]
            entry["z_mm"] = round(pt.z * MM, 3)
        except Exception:
            pass
        res.append(entry)
    return res

def _select_geometry(op, body, geometry):
    """Commit geometry selection for a 2D-milling or drilling op. geometry:
        {"faces":[idx,...], "type":"pocket"|"contour"|"drill",
         "loop":"OnlyOutsideLoops"|..., "side":"AlwaysInsideSideType"|...}
    For drilling-family strategies (drill, center drill, spot drill, bore,
    counterbore, tap) pass type="drill" with the hole's cylindrical faces."""
    sel_type = geometry.get("type", "pocket")

    # Drilling ops carry their geometry on a 'holeModel' parameter whose value is a
    # CadObjectParameterValue — not the 'pockets'/'contours' curve params used by 2D
    # milling. Geometry is committed by assigning .value a PLAIN LIST of the hole's
    # cylindrical faces (an ObjectCollection is rejected by the vector<Base> typemap).
    if sel_type in ("drill", "hole", "holes"):
        p = op.parameters.itemByName("holeModel")
        if p is None:
            raise RuntimeError("operation has no 'holeModel' geometry parameter — "
                               "type='drill' needs a drilling-family strategy")
        cv = adsk.cam.CadObjectParameterValue.cast(p.value)
        cv.value = [body.faces.item(i) for i in geometry["faces"]]
        return

    param_name = "pockets" if sel_type == "pocket" else "contours"
    p = op.parameters.itemByName(param_name)
    if p is None:
        raise RuntimeError(f"operation has no {param_name!r} geometry parameter "
                           f"for this strategy")
    cv = adsk.cam.CadContours2dParameterValue.cast(p.value)
    css = cv.getCurveSelections()
    css.clear()
    faces_sel = [body.faces.item(i) for i in geometry["faces"]]
    if sel_type == "pocket":
        sel = css.createNewPocketSelection()
        sel.inputGeometry = faces_sel
    else:
        sel = css.createNewFaceContourSelection()
        try:
            sel.inputGeometry = faces_sel
        except Exception:
            # Fusion rejects a vertical wall face here with the cryptic "Chosen
            # geometry is not compatible with input type". A face-contour traces the
            # OUTER BOUNDARY of a HORIZONTAL face, so steer the caller to the right
            # geometry instead of letting them churn on the opaque message.
            raise RuntimeError(
                "contour face-selection rejected face(s) "
                f"{geometry['faces']}: a contour traces the boundary of a HORIZONTAL "
                "face (e.g. the pocket opening / top face), so to finish pocket WALLS "
                "pass that opening face with side='AlwaysInsideSideType' — NOT the "
                "vertical wall faces, which are not valid contour input.") from None
        loop = geometry.get("loop")
        side = geometry.get("side")
        if loop:
            sel.loopType = _enum_member(adsk.cam.LoopTypes, loop, "geometry 'loop'")
        if side:
            sel.sideType = _enum_member(adsk.cam.SideTypes, side, "geometry 'side'")
    cv.applyCurveSelections(css)"
}
